items.title: Sisecam Will Bring the Future of Climate-Resilient Cities to the Forefront at COP31
items.summary: Can Yucel - Şişecam CEO Can Yucel - Şişecam CEO ISTANBUL, Oct. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Sisecam, the only global player operating in all core areas of glass, has become the Climate Supporter of the 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31), which will be held in Antalya on November 9-20.
